purpose: Offline bounded sandbox candidate plan; not an upload inventory, ledger or release approval
execution_order: Synthetic first, verify exact readback and unchanged retry; then FGDC-100, FGDC-1839, FGDC-3682 one at a time if fresh authenticated inventory permits.
credential_provisioned: Confirmed externally in designated provider environment only; never copied into code-owner environment
authenticated_account_verified: Initial authenticated probe externally reported; executor must privately verify intended owner and complete fresh inventory before write

readback_checks: Returned positive integer draft ID belongs to the authenticated intended account and sandbox host
Draft is unsubmitted and never done/published; no publish/community-submission action
Metadata matches expected_metadata_sha256 using existing compare_metadata semantics; source-backed metadata unchanged
Exactly one original XML attachment, exact basename/size/MD5; downloaded bytes match pinned SHA-256
Source SHA-256, artifact policy/contract and payload hash match selection before any write
Reserved DOI, if returned, and draft ID are recorded and preserved across all retries; no production DOI assigned
idempotency_checks: Persist create intent before POST and returned ID before metadata/file operations
Execute candidates serially under existing environment ledger lock with one writer
Repeat exact unchanged payloads and same durable ledger: zero new creates, same IDs/DOIs, metadata/files verified
Unknown POST result stops for read-only reconciliation; never clear ledger or repeat POST
After partial failure resume known ID; skip already matching XML upload; no DELETE
Changed payload/source, unexpected files, stale/incomplete inventory, cross-host bucket or identity mismatch stops
pending_gates: Bounded authenticated GET and intended-account/ownership verification
Fresh complete sandbox owned/community inventory and genuine exact-payload duplicate decision
Separate independently verified synthetic payload and successful upload/readback/retry
Independent final exact selection verification after live inventory; unsupported historical duplicate exception is not bypassed

synthetic.source_status: synthetic transport only, not actual-source QA

authorization_scope: User authorized bounded sandbox draft canary only; all execution gates and exact selection checks remain mandatory. No production/publication/deletion.
